hero.heading: Gadsden County School District Calendar 2026–2027
hero.mobileDescription: Gadsden County School District students start August 11, 2026, and finish May 26, 2027 (half day). Students have November 20 off, return January 5 after winter break, and take spring break March 15–19.
hero.desktopDescription: Gadsden County School District students have November 20 off before Thanksgiving week and return from winter break January 5. Spring break is March 15–19, followed by four scheduled school days before the separate Good Friday holiday. The year begins August 11 and ends May 26 with a half day.

editorialSummary.heading: November 20 is a day off; Good Friday falls after spring break
paragraphs: Friday, November 20, 2026, is a planning and professional-learning day, so students have no classes. Thanksgiving Holidays/Fall Break follows November 23–27. With the weekends, that gives students ten consecutive calendar days without regular classes, November 20–29. They are scheduled to return Monday, November 30.

Christmas/Winter Holidays begin December 21. Those holidays run through December 31, followed by New Year's Day on January 1 and a student-free planning day January 4. Classes resume Tuesday, January 5.

Spring break runs March 15–19, 2027. Students are scheduled to attend school March 22–25 before the separate Good Friday holiday on March 26. The two breaks do not run together. The school year ends Wednesday, May 26.

The confirmed half days are December 18, 2026, and May 26, 2027. Students attend on both dates, but the Student Calendar does not provide dismissal times. March 5 needs a separate check: the Student Calendar lists the end of the third grading period, while the Bus Drivers and Aides Calendar calls it a half day. Confirm pickup and bus times with your school rather than assume an early dismissal on March 5.
highlights: November 20 is a student-free planning day before November 23–27 fall break.
Students return after winter break on January 5, 2027.
March 22–25 are scheduled school days; Good Friday is March 26.

about.dataSource: The primary source is the first-page 2026-2027 Student Calendar in the district’s eight-page ALL CALENDARS PDF. It prints Approved January 27, 2026. The supplied local PDF and the current download linked from the district homepage and Support Services page have the same SHA-256.
about.processing: All eight scanned pages were rendered and visually reviewed. Page 1 controls the student schedule; pages 2-8 cover teachers, administrators, other employee groups, bus drivers and food service. Employee report dates, FTE surveys, paid-holiday counts, pre/postplanning and post-year Memorial Day are omitted from student events. No semester or report-card dates are inferred. There is no printed annual student total; 207 weekdays minus 28 explicit no-class weekdays gives a derived baseline of 179 attendance dates, counting half days as attendance. The bus drivers/aides page labels March 5 Half Day, while the student and teacher pages list only the third grading-period ending. Keep one grading milestone with a dismissal-confirmation note; do not assert a confirmed student half day or invent a closure. The disagreement concerns dismissal, not whether that date has attendance, and does not require an attendanceUncertaintyDates entry. The 2025-26 Bells & Buses document still linked from the homepage is not evidence for 2026-27 clock times. Named holidays stay separate from derived continuous spans; March 22-25 is not bridged into a vacation. No make-up dates or activation rules are invented.
about.updates: The current calendar download, homepage, full current news listing, Support Services and Transportation pages were checked October 19, 2026. No later student-calendar revision or notice resolving March 5 dismissal was verified. Check district and school announcements for weather closures, attendance changes and school-specific transportation arrangements. On October 22, 2026, the current ALL CALENDARS download was rechecked and its SHA-256 matched the stored source. Pages 1, 2 and 7 were visually reviewed for the student labels and March 5 dismissal discrepancy. The district homepage still links 2026-2027 Bus Routes, while its School Times PDF is labeled 2025-26. The 2025-26 School Times PDF is not used as evidence for 2026-27 bell or half-day dismissal times.
about.disclaimer: This is an independent reference for families following the district student calendar. Confirm dismissal times, separate programs, childcare, bus arrangements and later changes directly with your school.

faqs.question: When is the first day of school in Gadsden County for 2026–27?
faqs.answer: The first day for students is Tuesday, August 11, 2026. Earlier August dates in the combined district PDF are staff workdays, not student start dates.

faqs.question: When is the last day of school in Gadsden County in 2027?
faqs.answer: Wednesday, May 26, 2027, is the last student day. It is a half day and the end of the fourth grading period. Confirm your school's dismissal time before arranging pickup.

faqs.question: When is Thanksgiving break in Gadsden County in 2026?
faqs.answer: The district lists Thanksgiving Holidays/Fall Break for November 23–27, 2026. Students also have Friday, November 20, off for planning and professional learning. Classes are scheduled to resume Monday, November 30.

faqs.question: Is there school on Friday, November 20, 2026?
faqs.answer: No. November 20 is a student-free planning and professional-learning day. Together with Thanksgiving week and the weekends, it gives students November 20–29 away from regular classes.

faqs.question: Does Gadsden County have a separate fall break in October?
faqs.answer: The 2026–27 Student Calendar does not list a separate October fall-break week. October 12 is a student-free planning day. The break labeled Thanksgiving Holidays/Fall Break is November 23–27.

faqs.question: When is winter break in Gadsden County for 2026–27?
faqs.answer: Christmas/Winter Holidays run December 21–31, 2026. New Year's Day on January 1 and a student-free planning day on January 4 extend the time without regular classes. December 18 is a half day, and students return January 5.

faqs.question: When do students return after winter break in January 2027?
faqs.answer: Students return Tuesday, January 5, 2027. Monday, January 4, is a planning and professional-learning day with no student classes.

faqs.question: When is spring break in Gadsden County in 2027?
faqs.answer: Spring break runs March 15–19, 2027. Including the surrounding weekends, students are away from regular classes March 13–21. Classes are scheduled to resume Monday, March 22.

faqs.question: Are Gadsden County schools closed on Good Friday in 2027?
faqs.answer: Yes. Friday, March 26, 2027, is a district holiday with no student classes. It is separate from spring break. March 22–25 are scheduled school days between the two breaks.

faqs.question: When are planning days with no school for students in 2026–27?
faqs.answer: Students have no classes on October 12 and November 20, 2026, or January 4, 2027. These are district planning and professional-learning days.

faqs.question: Is there school on Labor Day in 2026?
faqs.answer: No. Monday, September 7, 2026, is Labor Day and a district holiday with no student classes.

faqs.question: Is there school on Veterans Day in 2026?
faqs.answer: No. Wednesday, November 11, 2026, is a district holiday, so students have no classes.

faqs.question: Is there school on Martin Luther King Jr. Day in 2027?
faqs.answer: No. Monday, January 18, 2027, is Martin Luther King Jr. Day and a district holiday with no student classes.

faqs.question: Is there school on Presidents Day in 2027?
faqs.answer: No. Monday, February 15, 2027, is Presidents Day and a district holiday with no student classes.

faqs.question: When are half days in Gadsden County schools in 2026–27?
faqs.answer: The district Student Calendar lists December 18, 2026, and May 26, 2027, as half days. Students attend on both dates. Check your school for dismissal times. March 5 has a separate scheduling discrepancy that needs confirmation.

faqs.question: Is March 5, 2027, a half day for students?
faqs.answer: It is not confirmed on the Student Calendar. March 5 is listed there as the end of the third grading period, while the Bus Drivers and Aides Calendar labels it Half Day. Ask your school about dismissal and bus service for that date.

faqs.question: What time are students dismissed on half days?
faqs.answer: The district's Student Calendar does not give dismissal times. Ask your school for its 2026–27 half-day schedule and confirm bus or pickup arrangements. The district Transportation Department can be reached at 850-627-6858.

faqs.question: Where can I find 2026–27 school times and bus routes?
faqs.answer: The district homepage links to a 2026–27 Bus Routes document. Its School Times PDF, however, is labeled 2025–26. For current bell times and half-day dismissal schedules, contact your school or the Transportation Department at 850-627-6858.

faqs.question: When do the four grading periods end in 2026–27?
faqs.answer: The grading periods end October 9 and December 18, 2026, and March 5 and May 26, 2027. December 18 and May 26 are confirmed half days. A grading-period ending does not automatically mean a full day off.

faqs.question: When will Gadsden County students receive report cards?
faqs.answer: The Student Calendar gives grading-period ending dates but does not list report-card release dates. Check messages from your school and the district's FOCUS parent portal for grade and report-card updates.

faqs.question: How many student attendance days are scheduled in 2026–27?
faqs.answer: Based on the dates listed in the district Student Calendar, there are 179 scheduled attendance days, including the two confirmed half days. That is 207 weekdays from August 11 through May 26, minus 28 days without classes. The district does not print this annual total in the calendar.

faqs.question: Are hurricane or weather make-up days listed on the calendar?
faqs.answer: The Student Calendar does not identify specific make-up dates or a schedule for using them. If severe weather or another emergency changes the school schedule, check district and school announcements for confirmed adjustments.

faqs.question: Where can I download the official 2026–27 Gadsden County school calendar?
faqs.answer: Download the 2026–2027 ALL CALENDARS PDF from the district's Support Services page. The Student Calendar is on page 1. The other pages cover teachers and additional employee groups, whose schedules are not identical to the student calendar.

faqs.question: Does the 2026–27 calendar apply to every school in Gadsden County?
faqs.answer: This page follows the Gadsden County School District Student Calendar. Independently operated charter schools and other separate programs may use different schedules. Check directly with your school if you are unsure which calendar applies.
